WITH new_york_hotels AS (
    SELECT h."id", h."name"
    FROM "hotel" h
    JOIN "city" c ON h."city_id" = c."id"
    WHERE LOWER(c."name") = 'new york'
),
hotels_with_pool AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT nyh."id", nyh."name", TRUE AS has_swimming_pool, FALSE AS has_hot_tub
    FROM new_york_hotels nyh
    JOIN "roomtype" rt ON nyh."id" = rt."hotel_id"
    JOIN "featureinroom" fir ON rt."id" = fir."roomtype_id"
    JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON fir."leisurefeature_id" = lf."id"
    WHERE LOWER(lf."feature") = 'swimming pool'
),
hotels_with_hot_tub AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT nyh."id", nyh."name", FALSE AS has_swimming_pool, TRUE AS has_hot_tub
    FROM new_york_hotels nyh
    JOIN "roomtype" rt ON nyh."id" = rt."hotel_id"
    JOIN "featureinroom" fir ON rt."id" = fir."roomtype_id"
    JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON fir."leisurefeature_id" = lf."id"
    WHERE LOWER(lf."feature") = 'hot tub'
)

SELECT
    COALESCE(hp."name", ht."name") AS "hotel_name",
    COALESCE(hp.has_swimming_pool, FALSE) AS "has_swimming_pool",
    COALESCE(ht.has_hot_tub, FALSE) AS "has_hot_tub"
FROM hotels_with_pool hp
FULL OUTER JOIN hotels_with_hot_tub ht ON hp."id" = ht."id"
ORDER BY "hotel_name";

SELECT DISTINCT
    t.name AS tourist_name,
    CASE
        WHEN t.activity LIKE '%Tourist Attraction%' THEN 'Tourist Attraction'
        WHEN t.activity LIKE '%Local Market%' THEN 'Local Market'
    END AS visit_type
FROM
    tourists t
JOIN
    visitrecords vr ON t.id = vr.touristattractionid
JOIN
    visitors v ON vr.visitorid = v.id
WHERE
    t.location LIKE '%Portobello%'
    AND (
        t.activity LIKE '%Tourist Attraction%'
        OR t.activity LIKE '%Local Market%'
    )
57:
SELECT DISTINCT t."name" AS tourist_name,
       CASE
           WHEN t."activity" LIKE '%Tourist Attraction%' THEN 'Tourist Attraction'
           WHEN t."activity" LIKE '%Local Market%' AND m."location" LIKE '%Portobello%' THEN 'Local Market in Portobello'
       END AS visit_type
FROM "tourists" t
LEFT JOIN "visitrecords" vr ON t."id"::BIGINT = vr."touristattractionid"::BIGINT
LEFT JOIN "markets" m ON vr."localmarketid"::BIGINT = m."id"::BIGINT
WHERE t."activity" LIKE '%Tourist Attraction%'
   OR (t."activity" LIKE '%Local Market%' AND m."location" LIKE '%Portobello%')
ORDER BY t."name";

WITH portobello_location AS (
    SELECT "id"
    FROM "locations"
    WHERE "locationname" = 'Portobello'
),
portobello_attractions AS (
    SELECT "id"
    FROM "tourists"
    WHERE "location" = 'Portobello'
      AND "activity" = 'Tourist Attraction'
),
portobello_markets AS (
    SELECT "id"
    FROM "markets"
    WHERE "location" = 'Portobello'
),
visitor_attractions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "visitorid"
    FROM "visitrecords"
    WHERE "touristattractionid" IN (SELECT "id" FROM portobello_attractions)
),
visitor_markets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "visitorid"
    FROM "visitrecords"
    WHERE "localmarketid" IN (SELECT "id" FROM portobello_markets)
)
SELECT t."name"
FROM "tourists" t
WHERE t."id" IN (
    SELECT "visitorid" FROM visitor_attractions
    INTERSECT
    SELECT "visitorid" FROM visitor_markets
);
